front: What is Zed config in one sentence?
back: ~/.config/zed/settings.json — themes, LSP, formatters, inline edit predictions, and remote editing over SSH.

front: Explain the mental model of Zed config (how the system thinks).
back: Zed reads JSON settings (user + optional project .zed/settings.json). Language servers attach per language block. Remote files use zed ssh://user@host/path with remote LSP when configured. Precedence: project overrides user for same keys.

front: What are the production-safe defaults for Zed config?
back: Goal: grey inline hint at the cursor — not the LSP popup menu.

front: Symptom: Popup on every key, no ghost text — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: show_completions_on_input · Fix: Set false; enable show_edit_predictions + edit_predictions.mode: "eager"

front: Symptom: Ghost text never appears — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Signed in to Zed AI / Copilot? · Fix: edit_predictions.provider; status bar Z/Copilot icon

front: Symptom: Ghost text blocked by popup — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Both LSP + predictions active · Fix: show_completions_on_input: false or hold alt to preview inline

front: Symptom: tab inserts tab, not hint — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Completion menu open · Fix: esc dismiss menu, or use alt-l / keymap above

front: Symptom: Only want LSP, no AI ghost — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: show_edit_predictions · Fix: Set false; use ctrl-space for menu

front: Symptom: int/int16 still in popup only — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: LSP limitation in Zed · Fix: Expected — no inline LSP setting exists yet; use menu or edit predictions

front: Symptom: Remote open fails — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: SSH key, host · Fix: ssh user@host first; fix ~/.ssh/config

front: Symptom: ESLint still runs — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Language server list · Fix: Use "!eslint" suffix; restart Zed

front: Symptom: Format on save no-op — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Formatter set? · Fix: Add "formatter": "prettier" + project config

front: Symptom: LSP not found — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: which typescript-language-server · Fix: Install globally or via mise/nvm

front: Gotcha with Zed config: what silently fails?
back: LSP completions are always a popup in Zed — you cannot make gopls/TS type lists render as inline ghost text (unlike VS Code inline suggest for some providers).

front: When should you NOT use Zed config?
back: Don't disable all linters globally to silence one noisy rule — fix rule or use local override. Don't commit machine-specific absolute paths in shared .zed/settings.json.
